estateResourceId.description: Public identifier minted by the digital estate hosting the supplier intake (e.g. nabhold/thamani, nabhold/zuribeans); never a database primary key.

canonicalOrganisationId.description: Reserved for the canonical Organisation identifier once nabhold/baobab-cp implements one and contracts/erp/v1/system-of-record.yaml's Organisation concept is assigned an owner. Null until then; no producer of this contract may mint a value here.

applicationStatus.description: The proven lifecycle from nabhold/zuribeans ADR-0006, reused as the canonical wire-level status set. A hosting estate whose process genuinely differs may propose extending this enum via a versioned contract change; it must not invent parallel status strings out of band.
